intro.en: Speech recognition turns audio into text. Speech synthesis turns text into audio. Most questions ask which feature fits.
intro.ro: Speech recognition audio ko text banata hai. Speech synthesis text ko audio banata hai. Zyada tar sawal poochte hain ke kaunsa feature munasib hai.

text.en: Text while people speak: captions, dictation, voice commands.
text.ro: Bolte waqt text: captions, dictation, voice commands.

text.en: Fast: one recorded file with a quick answer. Batch: many stored files, asynchronous.
text.ro: Fast: ek record file ka jaldi jawab. Batch: bohat si mehfooz files, asynchronous.
Batata hai ke kis speaker ne kya kaha.

text.en: Better recognition of special words. A phrase list is quick; custom speech trains a model.
text.ro: Khaas alfaaz ki behtar pehchan. Phrase list jaldi banti hai; custom speech model train karta hai.

text.en: Detects which of several candidate languages is spoken.
text.ro: Di gayi zabaanon mein se boli gayi zabaan pehchanta hai.

text.en: Natural ready-made voices, or an own brand voice with limited access and consent of the speaker.
text.ro: Qudrati tayyar awaazein, ya apni brand awaaz jis ke liye limited access aur speaker ki ijazat chahiye.

text.en: XML that controls voice, speed, pitch, pauses and pronunciation.
text.ro: XML jo awaaz, raftaar, pitch, waqfe aur talaffuz control karta hai.

text.en: Speech in one language, text or speech in others.
text.ro: Ek zabaan ki awaaz, doosri zabaanon ka text ya awaaz.

text.en: Capture, MFCC features, acoustic model (phonemes), language model (words), decoding, post-processing.
text.ro: Capture, MFCC features, acoustic model (phonemes), language model (alfaaz), decoding, post-processing.
Text normalization (poore alfaaz), phonemes, prosody, vocoder.

title.en: Example: SSML for a slow, clear announcement
title.ro: Misaal: aahista aur saaf elaan ke liye SSML

text.en: prosody makes the speech slower, break adds a pause, and say-as reads the number as digits.
text.ro: prosody awaaz aahista karta hai, break waqfa deta hai, aur say-as number ko ek ek hindsa parhta hai.

example.code:
<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="en-US"
  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis">
  <voice name="en-US-JennyNeural">
    <prosody rate="-20%">
      Your code is <break time="500ms"/>
      <say-as interpret-as="digits">4471</say-as>
    </prosody>
  </voice>
</speak>

rows.en: Who said what in a meeting
rows.ro: Meeting mein kis ne kya kaha

remember.en: Recognition = speech to text. Synthesis = text to speech.
remember.ro: Recognition = awaaz se text. Synthesis = text se awaaz.

remember.en: SSML is for synthesis; phrase lists are for recognition.
remember.ro: SSML synthesis ke liye hai; phrase list recognition ke liye.

remember.en: Batch is for many stored files, not for live audio.
remember.ro: Batch bohat si mehfooz files ke liye hai, live audio ke liye nahi.

traps.en: Diarization separates speakers; it does not know their names.
traps.ro: Diarization speakers alag karta hai; un ke naam nahi janta.

traps.en: Language identification picks from candidates that you give; it does not translate.
traps.ro: Language identification aap ki di hui zabaanon mein se chunta hai; tarjuma nahi karta.

traps.en: The vocoder belongs to synthesis, the acoustic model of phonemes to recognition.
traps.ro: Vocoder synthesis ka hissa hai, phonemes wala acoustic model recognition ka.
